## Research

<div class="home-research-intro">
My research develops statistical methodology for complex structured data, with emphasis on spatial and spatiotemporal processes, differential inference, scalable computation, and non-Euclidean domains.
</div>

::: {.research-grid}

::: {.research-card}
### Spatial Derivatives & Boundaries

Methods for inference on gradients, directional change, boundaries, wombling, and curvature.

[Explore →](research.qmd)
:::

::: {.research-card}
### Statistics on Manifolds

Gaussian processes and differential inference over complex geometric domains.

[Explore →](research.qmd)
:::

::: {.research-card}
### Scalable Spatial Computation

Computational methods for complex Bayesian spatial and spatiotemporal models.

[Explore →](research.qmd)
:::
